product.name: Core Test
product.description: A comprehensive lab test analyzing over 100 biomarkers to assess various health indicators and risks.

product.name: Advanced Labs (Optional Add-ons)
product.description: Specialized tests focusing on specific health areas such as heavy metals, allergies, fertility, and infections.

identifier.value: Clinician-Reviewed Insights and Personalized Action Plan

product.name: Clinician-Reviewed Insights and Personalized Action Plan
product.description: Medical review of lab results with tailored health recommendations and lifestyle guidance.

product.name: 1:1 Consultation with a Clinician
product.description: Personalized one-on-one sessions with a medical professional to discuss test results and health plans.

product.name: Dedicated 1:1 Health Coaching
product.description: Ongoing personalized coaching to support health goals and implementation of recommendations.

product.name: Health Tracking Dashboard
product.description: A digital platform for users to monitor health data, track progress, and manage retesting schedules.
